description: A replica of QuestDB's taxi dashboard on our stack: one week of 2015 replayed to the New York clock, with animated H3 flows, brushable arcs and DuckDB reading a local Parquet file. Requires testdata/make-taxidata.py.

options.content:
## New York City taxis, live
One real week of 2015 — 3.09 million trips — replayed to the New York clock: the same weekday and the same time of day as there right now. Refreshes every 5 seconds.

panels.description: Each animated line joins two H3 hexagons with trips between them; its width and color say how many. The circle at each hexagon splits into what leaves and what arrives. Everything is computed in DuckDB over a local Parquet file on every refresh.

targets.rawSql:
-- The replay clock: the current time in New York, carried over to the week of
-- Monday 14 September 2015 with the same weekday and time of day. The data
-- holds New York wall-clock time, with no time zone.
WITH clock AS (
  SELECT TIMESTAMP '2015-09-14'
         + ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')
            - date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')) AS t
)
-- One flow per pair of H3 hexagons (resolution 8, ~0.7 km²) with trips that
-- started in the last 10 minutes. origin_h3/dest_h3/trips are names the panel
-- recognizes on its own to build the flow layer.
SELECT pickup_h3_8 AS origin_h3,
       dropoff_h3_8 AS dest_h3,
       count(*)::BIGINT AS trips
FROM read_parquet('/testdata/taxi/trips-2015-w38.parquet'), clock
WHERE (
    (pickup_time > t - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND pickup_time <= t)
    -- Past midnight on Monday, the window carries on at the end of Sunday.
    OR (pickup_time > t + INTERVAL 7 DAY - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND pickup_time <= t + INTERVAL 7 DAY)
  )
  AND pickup_h3_8 <> dropoff_h3_8
GROUP BY 1, 2

         + ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')
            - date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')) AS t
)
-- Since midnight in New York. The sum() is cast: without it Grafana receives a
-- HUGEINT as text and the stat cannot draw it.
SELECT count(*)::BIGINT AS trips,
       sum(total)::DOUBLE AS revenue
FROM read_parquet('/testdata/taxi/trips-2015-w38.parquet'), clock
WHERE pickup_time >= date_trunc('day', t) AND pickup_time <= t

panels.description: Each arc is a trip from the last 10 minutes, cyan where it starts and magenta where it ends. With the cursor over the map, only the arcs that start or end within 0.7 km remain. Underneath, in amber, the same trips aggregated neighborhood to neighborhood (H3 hexagons of ~5 km²); those lines do not react to the cursor.

targets.rawSql:
-- The replay clock: the current time in New York, carried over to the week of
-- Monday 14 September 2015 with the same weekday and time of day. The data
-- holds New York wall-clock time, with no time zone.
WITH clock AS (
  SELECT TIMESTAMP '2015-09-14'
         + ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')
            - date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')) AS t
)
-- The same trips aggregated to large hexagons (H3 resolution 7, ~5 km²):
-- from which neighborhood to which, without street-level detail.
SELECT pickup_h3_7 AS origin_h3,
       dropoff_h3_7 AS dest_h3,
       count(*)::BIGINT AS trips
FROM read_parquet('/testdata/taxi/trips-2015-w38.parquet'), clock
WHERE (
    (pickup_time > t - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND pickup_time <= t)
    -- Past midnight on Monday, the window carries on at the end of Sunday.
    OR (pickup_time > t + INTERVAL 7 DAY - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND pickup_time <= t + INTERVAL 7 DAY)
  )
  AND pickup_h3_7 <> dropoff_h3_7
GROUP BY 1, 2

-- The replay clock: the current time in New York, carried over to the week of
-- Monday 14 September 2015 with the same weekday and time of day. The data
-- holds New York wall-clock time, with no time zone.
WITH clock AS (
  SELECT TIMESTAMP '2015-09-14'
         + ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')
            - date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')) AS t
)
-- One arc per trip in the last 10 minutes. pickup_lat/pickup_lon and
-- dropoff_lat/dropoff_lon are names the panel recognizes as origin and destination.
-- The fare is `amount`, not `total`: the panel reads a column named `total` as a
-- flow count and renames it.
SELECT pickup_lat, pickup_lon, dropoff_lat, dropoff_lon,
       passengers,
       total AS amount
FROM read_parquet('/testdata/taxi/trips-2015-w38.parquet'), clock
WHERE (
    (pickup_time > t - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND pickup_time <= t)
    -- Past midnight on Monday, the window carries on at the end of Sunday.
    OR (pickup_time > t + INTERVAL 7 DAY - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND pickup_time <= t + INTERVAL 7 DAY)
  )

panels.title: Trip by trip · hover over the map to see what leaves and arrives in each area

targets.rawSql:
-- The replay clock: the current time in New York, carried over to the week of
-- Monday 14 September 2015 with the same weekday and time of day. The data
-- holds New York wall-clock time, with no time zone.
WITH clock AS (
  SELECT TIMESTAMP '2015-09-14'
         + ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')
            - date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')) AS t
)
-- Trips per minute since midnight, returned as instants of today so that
-- Grafana's time axis puts them in place.
SELECT (time_bucket(INTERVAL 1 MINUTE, pickup_time)
        + (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') - date_trunc('day', t)))
       AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AS time,
       count(*)::BIGINT AS "Trips per minute"
FROM read_parquet('/testdata/taxi/trips-2015-w38.parquet'), clock
WHERE pickup_time >= date_trunc('day', t) AND pickup_time <= t
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Each dot is a trip paid with a tip in the last half hour.

targets.rawSql:
-- The replay clock: the current time in New York, carried over to the week of
-- Monday 14 September 2015 with the same weekday and time of day. The data
-- holds New York wall-clock time, with no time zone.
WITH clock AS (
  SELECT TIMESTAMP '2015-09-14'
         + ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')
            - date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')) AS t
)
-- Tip against fare for trips in the last 30 minutes. Only trips paid with a
-- tip: cash tips are not recorded.
SELECT fare AS "Fare",
       tip AS "Tip"
FROM read_parquet('/testdata/taxi/trips-2015-w38.parquet'), clock
WHERE (
    (pickup_time > t - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE AND pickup_time <= t)
    -- Past midnight on Monday, the window carries on at the end of Sunday.
    OR (pickup_time > t + INTERVAL 7 DAY - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE AND pickup_time <= t + INTERVAL 7 DAY)
  )
  AND fare BETWEEN 2.5 AND 70 AND tip > 0 AND tip < 15

panels.title: Tip against fare · last 30 minutes

options.content: **How it's built.** A Parquet file read by the DuckDB data source and four kepler.gl panels; the flows come straight from columns named `origin_h3`, `dest_h3` and `trips`, and the arcs from `pickup_lat`/`pickup_lon` and `dropoff_lat`/`dropoff_lon`. **Data:** NYC Taxi & Limousine Commission, yellow and green cabs, 14–20 Sep 2015, extracted from [QuestDB's public demo](https://demo.questdb.io). Inspired by their [taxi dashboard](https://questdb.com/dashboards/taxi/).
